name: io.github.KOBIL-GmbH/kobil-sdk-integration
description: KOBIL mobile SDK integration for AI coding agents: version-pinned guidance, preflights and read-only/guarded IDP and AST administration for native iOS/Android and Flutter apps.

environmentVariables.name: KOBIL_SDK_CONNECTION
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local connection JSON/age selector for the KOBIL IDP/AST environment (no credentials inside; optional, planning tools work without it).

environmentVariables.name: KOBIL_SDK_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the app project this server is bound to (optional).
